name: assisted trunk flex chest stretch
description: A partner-assisted chest stretch in which two people face each other, support one another's arms and hinge forward together.
instructions: Face a partner and stand far enough apart to extend your arms comfortably.
Hold each other's forearms or shoulders gently, then hinge forward at the hips with soft knees.
Let your chests sink between your extended arms until you feel a comfortable stretch across the front of the shoulders and chest.
Keep the pull gentle, breathe steadily, then both stand up slowly.
